title: Element names (English)
description: The names and one-line descriptions Studio shows for HTML elements, and the names of the Insert palette's categories (studio.md §5.3). English is the source catalog: every tag the palette offers has an entry here, and a translation is a copy of this file under data/locales/<language>/ with the values translated and the keys left alone.

h1.name: Heading 1
h1.description: The page's main title. A page usually has one.

h4.name: Heading 4
h4.description: A heading one level below Heading 3.

h5.name: Heading 5
h5.description: A heading one level below Heading 4.

blockquote.name: Quote
blockquote.description: A passage quoted from another source.

pre.name: Code block
pre.description: Text shown exactly as typed, spaces and line breaks included, in a fixed-width font.

hr.name: Divider
hr.description: A line that separates two parts of the page.

address.name: Contact details
address.description: Contact information for the page or for the article it is in.

ul.name: Bulleted list
ul.description: A list whose order does not matter.

ol.name: Numbered list
ol.description: A list whose order matters, such as steps.

li.name: List item
li.description: One item of a bulleted or numbered list.

dl.name: Description list
dl.description: Terms paired with their descriptions, such as a glossary or an FAQ.

dt.name: Term
dt.description: A term in a description list.

dd.name: Description
dd.description: The description of a term in a description list.

menu.name: Menu list
menu.description: A list of commands, such as the buttons of a toolbar.

figure.name: Figure
figure.description: An image, chart or code sample, with an optional caption.

audio.name: Audio
audio.description: A sound clip or a piece of music, with playback controls.

picture.name: Responsive image
picture.description: An image with alternative files for different screens and formats.

source.name: Media source
source.description: One alternative file for a video, an audio clip or a responsive image.

track.name: Text track
track.description: Captions or subtitles for a video or an audio clip.

iframe.name: Embedded page
iframe.description: Another web page shown inside this one, such as a map or a video player.

section.name: Section
section.description: A part of the page about one topic, usually with its own heading.

div.name: Container
div.description: A box that groups other elements and has no meaning of its own.

header.name: Header
header.description: Introductory content, such as a logo, a title or the navigation.

footer.name: Footer
footer.description: Closing content, such as copyright, contact links or related pages.

main.name: Main content
main.description: The page's central content. A page has one.

nav.name: Navigation
nav.description: A group of links to other pages or to parts of this one.

article.name: Article
article.description: Content that stands on its own, such as a blog post or a product card.

aside.name: Aside
aside.description: Content set apart from the main flow, such as a sidebar or a call-out.

search.name: Search area
search.description: The part of the page that holds a search form.

hgroup.name: Heading group
hgroup.description: A heading together with its subtitle or tagline.

a.name: Link
a.description: Text that takes the reader to another page, or to another place on this one.

details.name: Expandable section
details.description: Content the reader shows or hides by clicking its summary.

summary.name: Summary
summary.description: The always-visible label of an expandable section.

dialog.name: Dialog
dialog.description: A box shown over the page, such as a pop-up message.

form.name: Form
form.description: A group of fields the reader fills in and sends.

label.name: Field label
label.description: The text that names a form field.

input.name: Input field
input.description: A one-line field for text, numbers, dates, checkboxes and more.

textarea.name: Text area
textarea.description: A field for several lines of text.

select.name: Dropdown
select.description: A list of choices the reader picks from.

option.name: Option
option.description: One choice in a dropdown or a suggestion list.

optgroup.name: Option group
optgroup.description: A labelled group of choices in a dropdown.

datalist.name: Suggestion list
datalist.description: Values suggested while the reader types in a field.

fieldset.name: Field group
fieldset.description: A box around related fields, titled by its legend.

legend.name: Field group title
legend.description: The title of a field group.

output.name: Result
output.description: The result of a calculation or an action in a form.

progress.name: Progress bar
progress.description: How far a task has got.

meter.name: Meter
meter.description: A value within a known range, such as storage used.

thead.name: Table header
thead.description: The rows that head a table's columns.

tbody.name: Table body
tbody.description: The main rows of a table.

tfoot.name: Table footer
tfoot.description: The rows that sum up a table, such as totals.

th.name: Header cell
th.description: A cell that heads a row or a column.

colgroup.name: Column group
colgroup.description: A group of table columns styled together.

col.name: Column
col.description: One column of a column group.

span.name: Text span
span.description: A piece of text to style, with no meaning of its own.

strong.name: Important text
strong.description: Text that matters more than what surrounds it, shown in bold.

em.name: Emphasis
em.description: Text spoken with stress, shown in italics.

b.name: Bold
b.description: Text drawn in bold without extra importance, such as a keyword.

i.name: Italic
i.description: Text in an alternate voice, such as a foreign word or a thought.

u.name: Underline
u.description: Text marked with an underline, such as a misspelling.

s.name: Strikethrough
s.description: Text that is no longer accurate.

small.name: Small print
small.description: Side comments and fine print, such as a disclaimer.

mark.name: Highlight
mark.description: Text highlighted for reference, such as a search match.

code.name: Inline code
code.description: A short piece of code inside a sentence.

kbd.name: Keyboard input
kbd.description: Keys the reader presses, such as Ctrl+C.

var.name: Variable
var.description: A variable in a formula or in code.

sub.name: Subscript
sub.description: Text set below the line, as in H₂O.

sup.name: Superscript
sup.description: Text set above the line, as in 10².

q.name: Inline quote
q.description: A short quotation inside a sentence.

cite.name: Citation
cite.description: The title of a creative work, such as a book or a film.

abbr.name: Abbreviation
abbr.description: An abbreviation or an acronym, with its full form.

time.name: Date or time
time.description: A date or a time that software can read.

data.name: Data value
data.description: A value with a machine-readable form, such as a product code.

del.name: Deleted text
del.description: Text removed from a document, shown struck through.

ins.name: Inserted text
ins.description: Text added to a document, shown underlined.

br.name: Line break
br.description: Starts a new line inside the same paragraph.

wbr.name: Line break opportunity
wbr.description: A place a long word may wrap.

bdi.name: Isolated text direction
bdi.description: Text whose direction may differ from what surrounds it, such as a user name.

bdo.name: Text direction override
bdo.description: Text drawn in a direction you set.

ruby.name: Ruby annotation
ruby.description: Text with a small pronunciation guide above it, as in East Asian typography.

rt.name: Ruby text
rt.description: The pronunciation guide of a ruby annotation.

rp.name: Ruby fallback
rp.description: Parentheses shown around ruby text where ruby is not supported.

area.name: Image map area
area.description: A clickable region of an image map.

canvas.name: Drawing canvas
canvas.description: A surface a script draws graphics on.

embed.name: Embedded content
embed.description: Content from an external file, such as a plugin.

noscript.name: No-script fallback
noscript.description: Content shown when scripts are turned off.

object.name: External object
object.description: An external resource, such as a PDF.

selectedcontent.name: Selected option content
selectedcontent.description: Shows the chosen option inside a customised dropdown.

slot.name: Slot
slot.description: Where a component shows the content placed inside it.

template.name: Template
template.description: Content kept for a script to copy, not shown on the page.
